control.description-key: PBS Hub Ops Console P-3, P-4 and P-5: payroll lines per host with source attendance, the four-gate approval tracker, and payslip status.

property.name: PayrollJson
property.description-key: JSON of ONE [Payroll - PBS Hub] row (object or one-row array).

property.name: PayrollDataJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Payroll Data] for this run, plus HostID and NorekLast4 computed in canvas. Never send Employee_ID (KTP) or the full Norek.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for the data month of this run. Used for the expanded row and the source check.

property.name: PayslipJson
property.description-key: Optional. JSON rows of a payslip log (payroll_id, LineID or Employee_Email, Status, SentAt, Error). v1 has no such list: leave blank.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).
